profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: As a Software Engineer at Microsoft, I design and maintain systems that ingest and surface data from various tools like SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Data Explorer. I collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and data scientists to ensure the reliability, accessibility, and support of experimentation data for product-led growth. My work contributes to tools that improve experiment health, governance, and overall engineering effectiveness.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
I build experimentation and data integration platforms that help teams make informed, data-driven decisions using metrics and telemetry. I design and maintain systems that ingest and surface data from tools like SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Data Explorer.

My work involves close collaboration with engineers, PMs, and data scientists to ensure experimentation data is reliable, accessible, and supports product-led growth. By bridging technical implementation with cross-functional insights, I contribute to tools that improve experiment health, governance, and overall engineering effectiveness.

My work helps ensure other engineers can quickly pivot or double down on their product decisions with confidence, supporting faster iteration and product-led growth.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
TA for Data: Past, Present and Future. The course is taught in in conjunction between the Applied Math and History departments at Columbia University. 

Through a combination of labs and lectures, students learn the history of the human use of data along with the data science principles that have shaped our interpretation and usage of data.

company.name: Columbia University in the City of New York

positions.title: New Technologist Apprentice
positions.description:
Improved and expanded functionality for a Microsoft Teams based bot that facilitates troubleshooting and accessing information pertinent to feature flighting for the Office Experimentation team

Engineered back and forth dialogue capabilities, increasing the ease, friendliness and intelligence of the bot

Upgraded bot capabilities to provide a dashboard showing engineers the most vital information about a rollout without ever leaving the Teams app thereby reducing the clicks needed gather such information 

Implemented new telemetry methods to monitor bot usage and connected the data to a Power BI report that provides an organized view to rapidly interpret the data

positions.title: New Technologist Intern at Microsoft
positions.description:
Designed, planned and created AccountabiliBuddy: an app that encourages users to create and complete goals by tracking the user’s location to automatically update their goal progression and allowing friends to “nudge” each other

Conducted user research to gauge user needs and wants in order to develop an MVP with features that were most relevant to the user

Created wireframes from user scenarios, developed the front end of the app and implemented necessary structures to save user data

Chosen out of 15 teams to pitch AccountabiliBuddy to Microsoft M365 CVPs, Sr. Software Engineers and Sr.Program Managers

positions.title: Student Advocate
positions.description:
Worked with a cohort of students to ideate ways to create pathways for K - 12 students to pursue STEM careers

Presented at community events, attended quarterly trainings, blogged about STEM education and learning standards, advocated for career connected learning

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Implemented the Minimum Volume Simplex Analysis (MVSA) algorithm to be used for hyper-spectral unmixing

Improved algorithm design to incorporate usage scenarios specific to the Ginger Lab

Created documentation to support the upkeep and debugging of the algorithm

positions.title: Student Advisor
positions.description:
Mentored students of color and their families through a rigorous college prep program by helping them set their own goals and implement steps to achieve those goals.
 
Served as an intermediary between parents, students and program staff by identify and reporting the strengths and weaknesses of students.
